RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 35

An all-male panel reflects the demographic reality of senior banking rather than definitive proof of discrimination. While unconscious affinity bias can subtly influence interview outcomes, "broad experience of regulatory affairs" is a critical, legitimate qualification for a head of risk modelling, who must regularly navigate supervisory scrutiny. Two weeks is also a standard corporate timeframe for HR feedback.

Raising the panel's gender composition without concrete evidence of bias will likely be perceived as defensive and could damage your professional reputation in a specialized market. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on how to strengthen your regulatory profile for future leadership roles.
